journey.name: Starter: onboarding guidance matches the docs
journey.description: The starter tells a newcomer, on screen, the exact next steps the published quickstart describes: forge a sigil, then fund the wallet and register dust, with the mn commands to do it. If this text drifts from the docs the two disagree and the newcomer is stuck with no indication which is right — and no test would notice, because nothing else reads this string.

actions.action: Verify the screen shows "Forge a sigil above"
Verify the screen shows "fund the wallet and register dust"
Verify the screen shows "mn dust register"
